panels.title: Blah greet outcomes
panels.description: Procedure: Blah.Greet v1. Rate per second over the selected window, scoped to one scrape instance. ok means one greeting rendered for a non-empty name; empty_name means the request carried no name. Missing or stale targets show no data, not zero. Counters reset at restart and are not a ledger. No failure-rate baseline is calibrated.

panels.title: Blah greet duration p50/p95
panels.description: Procedure: Blah.Greet v1. Histogram estimates in seconds by outcome, scoped to one scrape instance and rate window; each attempt spans one render of the declared greeting. No samples, or an unavailable exporter, is Unknown, never a measured zero. No latency objective is calibrated.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, outcome) (rate(csf_blah_greet_duration_seconds_bucket{instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on() (max(up{instance="$instance"}) == 1)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, outcome) (rate(csf_blah_greet_duration_seconds_bucket{instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on() (max(up{instance="$instance"}) == 1)
